description.fallback: After Caesar flamboyantly sits down at a table, he and Joseph start up a game of poker. Both end up cheating and start to argue aimlessly until Speedwagon interrupts to ask why they've been waiting around for 8 hours. A moment later, a car arrives to take them to the other Pillar Men.
